scripts.lint: find . -name vendor -prune -o -name node_modules -prune -o -name .claude -prune -o -type f \( -name '*.php' -o -name '*.inc' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the PHPUnit suites. db, integration and http need FrontAccounting, its database and the GraphQL module beside this one - tools/ci.sh, run in the FrontAccounting CI image, provides them.
scripts-descriptions.lint: php -l over every PHP and .inc file in the module.
scripts-descriptions.cs:check: Check includes/service, includes/GraphQL and tests/ against PSR-12 (phpcs.xml).
scripts-descriptions.cs:fix: Fix what phpcbf can fix automatically.
scripts-descriptions.analyze: Run PHPStan at level 5 over includes/ and tests/ (phpstan.neon, with its baseline).
scripts-descriptions.quality: lint, cs:check, then analyze - the static gates.
scripts-descriptions.ci: quality, then test - the same gates tools/ci.sh runs in CI.
scripts-descriptions.package: Build the release zip and tarball (needs make.phar; see README).
